aws.c2b.emr.cluster_not_publicly_accessi.pass_when: The cluster has no public DNS name, or none of its node security groups opens all traffic or all ports to a public CIDR.
aws.c2b.emr.cluster_not_publicly_accessi.fail_when: The cluster has public DNS, and a primary or core/task group allows all traffic or 0-65535 from a public CIDR.
aws.c2b.emr.cluster_not_publicly_accessi.not_applicable_when: The cluster state is TERMINATED or TERMINATED_WITH_ERRORS.

aws.c2b.emr.cluster_security_configurati.description: Fails an EMR cluster whose DescribeCluster detail does not include a SecurityConfiguration name. The contents of the configuration are not inspected. A cluster launched without one gets EMR defaults: no at-rest or in-transit encryption, no Kerberos and no Lake Formation integration.
aws.c2b.emr.cluster_security_configurati.pass_when: A non-empty SecurityConfiguration name is attached.

aws.c2b.emr.master_no_public_dns.description: Fails a non-terminated EMR cluster whose MasterPublicDnsName contains '.amazonaws.com', which means the primary node has a public IP. Private names such as *.ec2.internal pass. A primary node with a public address can be reached from the internet whenever its security groups allow it, which exposes cluster management interfaces.
aws.c2b.emr.master_no_public_dns.pass_when: MasterPublicDnsName is absent or is an internal (non-.amazonaws.com) name.
aws.c2b.emr.master_no_public_dns.not_applicable_when: The cluster state is TERMINATED or TERMINATED_WITH_ERRORS.

aws.c2b.emr.master_subnet_no_auto_public.description: For EMR clusters in the RUNNING or WAITING state, looks up Ec2InstanceAttributes.Ec2SubnetId in the subnet inventory and fails if that subnet has MapPublicIpOnLaunch true (Security Hub EMR.1). A missing subnet gives UNKNOWN. Nodes launched there automatically get public IPv4 addresses, which puts the primary node on the internet.
aws.c2b.emr.master_subnet_no_auto_public.pass_when: The cluster's subnet has MapPublicIpOnLaunch false.
aws.c2b.emr.master_subnet_no_auto_public.fail_when: The cluster's subnet has MapPublicIpOnLaunch true.
aws.c2b.emr.master_subnet_no_auto_public.not_applicable_when: The cluster is not RUNNING or WAITING, for example STARTING, TERMINATING or TERMINATED.

aws.c2b.emr.security_configuration_at_re.description: Parses each EMR security configuration's JSON document itself, whether or not a cluster uses it, and fails when EncryptionConfiguration.EnableAtRestEncryption is not true (Security Hub EMR.3). A configuration without an EncryptionConfiguration block fails. Clusters launched from it later would keep EMRFS and local disk data unencrypted.
aws.c2b.emr.security_configuration_at_re.pass_when: EnableAtRestEncryption is true in the configuration document.
aws.c2b.emr.security_configuration_at_re.fail_when: EnableAtRestEncryption is false or missing, or there is no EncryptionConfiguration.

aws.c2b.emr.security_configuration_in_tr.description: Fails an EMR security configuration whose parsed EncryptionConfiguration does not set EnableInTransitEncryption to true (Security Hub EMR.4), and evaluates the configuration on its own. Any cluster launched with it would send inter-node and EMRFS traffic without TLS.
aws.c2b.emr.security_configuration_in_tr.fail_when: EnableInTransitEncryption is false or missing, or there is no EncryptionConfiguration.

aws.c2b.es.all_logs_to_cloudwatch.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when any of ES_APPLICATION_LOGS, SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS, or INDEX_SLOW_LOGS lacks Enabled=true or lacks a CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the opensearch domain is absent or delayed.
aws.c2b.es.all_logs_to_cloudwatch.pass_when: All three log types are enabled and name CloudWatch log groups.
aws.c2b.es.all_logs_to_cloudwatch.fail_when: Any of ES_APPLICATION_LOGS, SEARCH_SLOW_LOGS, or INDEX_SLOW_LOGS lacks Enabled=true or lacks a CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn.

aws.c2b.es.audit_logs_to_cloudwatch.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when AUDIT_LOGS is not enabled or has no CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the opensearch domain is absent or delayed.
aws.c2b.es.audit_logs_to_cloudwatch.pass_when: AUDIT_LOGS is enabled and names a CloudWatch log group.
aws.c2b.es.audit_logs_to_cloudwatch.fail_when: AUDIT_LOGS is not enabled or has no CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn.

aws.c2b.es.error_logs_to_cloudwatch.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when ES_APPLICATION_LOGS is not enabled or has no CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the opensearch domain is absent or delayed.
aws.c2b.es.error_logs_to_cloudwatch.pass_when: ES_APPLICATION_LOGS is enabled and names a CloudWatch log group.
aws.c2b.es.error_logs_to_cloudwatch.fail_when: ES_APPLICATION_LOGS is not enabled or has no CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn.

aws.c2b.es.in_vpc.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when DomainStatus.VPCOptions.VPCId is empty or absent. The network path can expose the opensearch domain to traffic from outside its intended boundary.

aws.c2b.es.internal_user_database_enable.description: Tests the source-specific OpenSearch internal user database enabled profile. It is incompatible on one domain with the disabled profile and does not alone prove secure authentication. Remediation: Enable the internal user database only when the source profile calls for it, and review fine-grained access control and identity governance.

aws.c2b.es.policy_prohibit_public_access.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when the collected AccessPolicies document has an unconditioned public Allow statement under the perimeter policy test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the opensearch domain or its data.
aws.c2b.es.policy_prohibit_public_access.pass_when: The present access policy has no public Allow statement under that test.
aws.c2b.es.policy_prohibit_public_access.fail_when: The collected AccessPolicies document has an unconditioned public Allow statement under the perimeter policy test.
aws.c2b.es.policy_prohibit_public_access.not_applicable_when: The domain has no AccessPolicies document.

aws.c2b.es.tls_1_2_policy.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when DomainEndpointOptions.TLSSecurityPolicy is neither Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-2019-07 nor Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-PFS-2023-10. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the opensearch domain.
aws.c2b.es.tls_1_2_policy.pass_when: The endpoint TLS policy is one of those two TLS 1.2 minimum policies.
aws.c2b.es.tls_1_2_policy.fail_when: DomainEndpointOptions.TLSSecurityPolicy is neither Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-2019-07 nor Policy-Min-TLS-1-2-PFS-2023-10.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_no_cross_.description: For each eventbridge bus, the evaluator flags FAIL when a bus policy allows a principal outside the audited account under the Prowler cross-account test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the eventbridge bus or its data.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_no_cross_.pass_when: No policy statement grants cross-account access, including when the policy is absent.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_no_cross_.fail_when: A bus policy allows a principal outside the audited account under the Prowler cross-account test.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_not_publi.description: For each eventbridge bus, the evaluator flags FAIL when the bus policy allows public access under Prowler's policy test using the audited account. This can give unintended external principals a route to the eventbridge bus or its data.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_not_publi.pass_when: No policy statement grants public access, including when the policy is absent.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_not_publi.fail_when: The bus policy allows public access under Prowler's policy test using the audited account.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_prohibit_.description: For each eventbridge bus, the evaluator flags FAIL when the present bus policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement under the perimeter test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the eventbridge bus or its data.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_prohibit_.pass_when: The present bus policy has no such public statement.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_prohibit_.fail_when: The present bus policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement under the perimeter test.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.bus_policy_prohibit_.not_applicable_when: The event bus has no policy document.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.custom_bus_policy_at.description: For each eventbridge bus, the evaluator flags FAIL when a non-default event bus has no Policy document. A broad resource policy can grant operations to principals beyond the intended trust boundary.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.custom_bus_policy_at.pass_when: The custom bus has a Policy document.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.custom_bus_policy_at.fail_when: A non-default event bus has no Policy document.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.global_endpoint_repl.description: For each eventbridge endpoint, the evaluator flags FAIL when ReplicationConfig.State is DISABLED or omitted. A zonal failure can interrupt the eventbridge endpoint when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.

aws.c2b.eventbridge.schema_registry_no_c.description: For each eventbridge schema registry, the evaluator flags FAIL when a non-AWS-owned schema registry policy permits an external account under Prowler's cross-account test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the eventbridge schema registry or its data.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.schema_registry_no_c.pass_when: The present registry policy grants no cross-account access.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.schema_registry_no_c.fail_when: A non-AWS-owned schema registry policy permits an external account under Prowler's cross-account test.
aws.c2b.eventbridge.schema_registry_no_c.not_applicable_when: The registry name starts with 'aws.' (AWS owned), or it has no policy document.

aws.c2b.firehose.encrypted_at_rest_or_ms.description: For each firehose delivery stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when a non-MSK-source delivery stream does not have DeliveryStreamEncryptionConfiguration.Status ENABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the firehose delivery stream.
aws.c2b.firehose.encrypted_at_rest_or_ms.pass_when: Encryption status is ENABLED or DeliveryStreamType is MSKAsSource.
aws.c2b.firehose.encrypted_at_rest_or_ms.fail_when: A non-MSK-source delivery stream does not have DeliveryStreamEncryptionConfiguration.Status ENABLED.

aws.c2b.fms.policies_compliant.description: Examines every returned Firewall Manager policy, account and evaluation status. It evaluates observed compliance rows, not organization-wide account completeness or effective firewall protection. Remediation: Review each observed NON_COMPLIANT policy/account evaluation and correct the affected policy or resources; verify organization account coverage separately.
aws.c2b.fms.policies_compliant.pass_when: Every observed policy/account evaluation is present and COMPLIANT.
aws.c2b.fms.policies_compliant.fail_when: Any observed evaluation is NON_COMPLIANT; missing, empty, malformed or unsupported evaluations are UNKNOWN unless another row proves failure.
aws.c2b.fms.policies_compliant.not_applicable_when: A complete regional FMS policy inventory is empty.

aws.c2b.lambda.env_vars_cmk.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when environment variables are present but KMSKeyArn is absent. An AWS-managed default key gives the account less control over key policy and disable or rotation decisions for this data.
aws.c2b.lambda.env_vars_cmk.pass_when: KMSKeyArn is set or the function has no environment variables.
aws.c2b.lambda.env_vars_cmk.fail_when: Environment variables are present but KMSKeyArn is absent.

aws.c2b.lambda.invoke_cloudtrail_logged.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when no collected CloudTrail selector covers the function ARN, the partition-wide Lambda ARN, or an advanced AWS::Lambda::Function resource type. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the lambda function is absent or delayed.
aws.c2b.lambda.invoke_cloudtrail_logged.pass_when: At least one CloudTrail selector covers the function by those exact tests.
aws.c2b.lambda.invoke_cloudtrail_logged.fail_when: No collected CloudTrail selector covers the function ARN, the partition-wide Lambda ARN, or an advanced AWS::Lambda::Function resource type.

aws.c2b.lambda.no_cross_account_layers.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when any Layers[].Arn contains an account ID different from the audited account. A layer publisher in another account can change code loaded into the function and read its execution-time secrets.
aws.c2b.lambda.no_cross_account_layers.pass_when: Every referenced layer ARN belongs to the audited account, or there are no layers.
aws.c2b.lambda.no_cross_account_layers.fail_when: Any Layers[].Arn contains an account ID different from the audited account.

aws.c2b.lambda.policy_not_public.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when the present Lambda resource policy grants public invoke access under Prowler's policy test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the lambda function or its data.
aws.c2b.lambda.policy_not_public.pass_when: The present resource policy does not grant public invoke access.
aws.c2b.lambda.policy_not_public.fail_when: The present Lambda resource policy grants public invoke access under Prowler's policy test.
aws.c2b.lambda.policy_not_public.not_applicable_when: The function has no resource policy.

aws.c2b.lambda.runtime_not_obsolete.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when Runtime is one of the evaluator's pinned obsolete runtime names. Known vulnerabilities can remain exploitable in the lambda function while it runs an old release.
aws.c2b.lambda.runtime_not_obsolete.pass_when: Runtime is present and absent from the pinned obsolete list.
aws.c2b.lambda.runtime_not_obsolete.fail_when: Runtime is one of the evaluator's pinned obsolete runtime names.

aws.c2b.lambda.url_cors_no_wildcard.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when FunctionUrl.Cors.AllowOrigins contains the string '*' anywhere in the list. A wildcard origin lets scripts on unrelated websites read responses from a browser-invoked function URL when other CORS requirements are met.
aws.c2b.lambda.url_cors_no_wildcard.pass_when: A configured function URL has no wildcard origin in AllowOrigins.
aws.c2b.lambda.url_cors_no_wildcard.fail_when: FunctionUrl.Cors.AllowOrigins contains the string '*' anywhere in the list.
aws.c2b.lambda.url_cors_no_wildcard.not_applicable_when: The function has no function URL.

aws.c2b.rds.cluster_snapshot_encrypted_a.description: For each rds cluster snapshot, the evaluator flags FAIL when StorageEncrypted is false for a DB cluster snapshot of any engine, including DocumentDB and Neptune. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the rds cluster snapshot.
aws.c2b.rds.cluster_snapshot_encrypted_a.pass_when: StorageEncrypted is true on the cluster snapshot.
aws.c2b.rds.cluster_snapshot_encrypted_a.fail_when: StorageEncrypted is false for a DB cluster snapshot of any engine, including DocumentDB and Neptune.

aws.c2b.rds.db_snapshot_encrypted.description: For each rds snapshot, the evaluator flags FAIL when Encrypted is false on a DB instance snapshot. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the rds snapshot.
aws.c2b.rds.db_snapshot_encrypted.pass_when: Encrypted is true on the DB instance snapshot.
aws.c2b.rds.db_snapshot_encrypted.fail_when: Encrypted is false on a DB instance snapshot.

aws.cb.apigatewayv2.stage_access_logging.description: For each http api stage, the evaluator flags FAIL when an API Gateway v2 stage has no AccessLogSettings object or it is empty. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the http api stage is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.apigatewayv2.stage_access_logging.fail_when: An API Gateway v2 stage has no AccessLogSettings object or it is empty.

aws.cb.firehose.server_side_encryption.description: For each firehose delivery stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when DeliveryStreamEncryptionConfiguration.Status is not ENABLED, including when it is omitted. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the firehose delivery stream.
aws.cb.firehose.server_side_encryption.pass_when: The delivery stream encryption status is ENABLED.
aws.cb.firehose.server_side_encryption.fail_when: DeliveryStreamEncryptionConfiguration.Status is not ENABLED, including when it is omitted.

aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_backups.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Windows, Lustre, or OpenZFS file system has its type-specific CopyTagsToBackups flag false. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the fsx file system.
aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_backups.pass_when: The applicable file-system configuration has CopyTagsToBackups true.
aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_backups.fail_when: A Windows, Lustre, or OpenZFS file system has its type-specific CopyTagsToBackups flag false.
aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_backups.not_applicable_when: The file-system type is ONTAP, which has no CopyTagsToBackups member in this evaluator.

aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_volumes.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when an OpenZFS file system has OpenZFSConfiguration.CopyTagsToVolumes false. A copied resource can lose owner and classification tags, obscuring retention and access reviews.
aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_volumes.pass_when: CopyTagsToVolumes is true on the OpenZFS configuration.
aws.cb.fsx.copy_tags_to_volumes.fail_when: An OpenZFS file system has OpenZFSConfiguration.CopyTagsToVolumes false.

aws.cb.fsx.lustre_copy_tags_to_backups.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Lustre file system has LustreConfiguration.CopyTagsToBackups false. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the fsx file system.
aws.cb.fsx.lustre_copy_tags_to_backups.pass_when: CopyTagsToBackups is true on the Lustre configuration.
aws.cb.fsx.lustre_copy_tags_to_backups.fail_when: A Lustre file system has LustreConfiguration.CopyTagsToBackups false.

aws.cb.fsx.ontap_multi_az.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ONTAP file system has DeploymentType outside MULTI_AZ_1 and MULTI_AZ_2. A zonal failure can interrupt the fsx file system when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.fsx.ontap_multi_az.pass_when: Its ONTAP DeploymentType is MULTI_AZ_1 or MULTI_AZ_2.
aws.cb.fsx.ontap_multi_az.fail_when: An ONTAP file system has DeploymentType outside MULTI_AZ_1 and MULTI_AZ_2.

aws.cb.fsx.openzfs_copy_tags_backups_and.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when an OpenZFS file system has either CopyTagsToBackups or CopyTagsToVolumes false. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the fsx file system.
aws.cb.fsx.openzfs_copy_tags_backups_and.pass_when: Both OpenZFS tag-copy flags are true.
aws.cb.fsx.openzfs_copy_tags_backups_and.fail_when: An OpenZFS file system has either CopyTagsToBackups or CopyTagsToVolumes false.

aws.cb.fsx.openzfs_multi_az.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when an OpenZFS file system's DeploymentType is not MULTI_AZ_1. A zonal failure can interrupt the fsx file system when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.fsx.openzfs_multi_az.fail_when: An OpenZFS file system's DeploymentType is not MULTI_AZ_1.

aws.cb.fsx.protected_by_backup_plan.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when no backup_protected_resource has both the file system ResourceARN and ResourceType FSx. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the fsx file system.
aws.cb.fsx.protected_by_backup_plan.pass_when: AWS Backup inventory contains a protected FSx resource with the file system ARN.
aws.cb.fsx.protected_by_backup_plan.fail_when: No backup_protected_resource has both the file system ResourceARN and ResourceType FSx.

aws.cb.fsx.windows_multi_az_deployment.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Windows file system's DeploymentType is not MULTI_AZ_1. A zonal failure can interrupt the fsx file system when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.fsx.windows_multi_az_deployment.fail_when: A Windows file system's DeploymentType is not MULTI_AZ_1.

aws.cb.fsx.windows_multiple_subnets.description: For each fsx file system, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Windows file system has fewer than two SubnetIds. A zonal failure can interrupt the fsx file system when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.fsx.windows_multiple_subnets.pass_when: Its SubnetIds list contains at least two entries.
aws.cb.fsx.windows_multiple_subnets.fail_when: A Windows file system has fewer than two SubnetIds.

aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_no_public_pr.description: For each glacier vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when an Allow statement has a wildcard Principal, regardless of conditions. This can give unintended external principals a route to the glacier vault or its data.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_no_public_pr.pass_when: The policy is absent or no Allow statement has a wildcard Principal.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_no_public_pr.fail_when: An Allow statement has a wildcard Principal, regardless of conditions.

aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_prohibit_pub.description: For each glacier vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when the present policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement under the perimeter test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the glacier vault or its data.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_prohibit_pub.pass_when: The present policy has no such unrestricted public statement.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_prohibit_pub.fail_when: The present policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement under the perimeter test.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_prohibit_pub.not_applicable_when: The vault has no access policy.

aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_star_princip.description: For each glacier vault, the evaluator flags FAIL when an Allow statement contains '*' in Principal, Principal.AWS, or Principal.CanonicalUser. A broad resource policy can grant operations to principals beyond the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_star_princip.pass_when: The policy is absent or no Allow statement has those wildcard principal forms.
aws.cb.glacier.vault_policy_star_princip.fail_when: An Allow statement contains '*' in Principal, Principal.AWS, or Principal.CanonicalUser.

aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_encryption.description: For each glue data catalog, the evaluator flags FAIL when CatalogEncryptionMode is exactly DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue data catalog.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_encryption.pass_when: CatalogEncryptionMode is any value other than DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_sse_kms_wit.description: For each glue data catalog, the evaluator flags FAIL when a region with Glue tables has CatalogEncryptionMode other than exactly SSE-KMS. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue data catalog.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_sse_kms_wit.pass_when: CatalogEncryptionMode is exactly SSE-KMS in a region with tables.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_sse_kms_wit.fail_when: A region with Glue tables has CatalogEncryptionMode other than exactly SSE-KMS.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_metadata_sse_kms_wit.not_applicable_when: The complete regional Glue table inventory is empty.

aws.cb.glue.catalog_password_encryption.description: For each glue data catalog, the evaluator flags FAIL when ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted is false. A caller retrieving Glue connection details may receive a reusable database password without the intended encrypted-return protection.

aws.cb.glue.catalog_password_encryption_.description: For each glue data catalog, the evaluator flags FAIL when a region with Glue tables has ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted false. A caller retrieving Glue connection details may receive a reusable database password without the intended encrypted-return protection.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_password_encryption_.pass_when: ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted is true in a region with tables.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_password_encryption_.fail_when: A region with Glue tables has ReturnConnectionPasswordEncrypted false.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_password_encryption_.not_applicable_when: The complete regional Glue table inventory is empty.

aws.cb.glue.catalog_policy_not_public.description: For each glue data catalog, the evaluator flags FAIL when the present Data Catalog resource policy is public under Prowler's audited-account test. This can give unintended external principals a route to the glue data catalog or its data.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_policy_not_public.pass_when: The present catalog policy does not allow public access.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_policy_not_public.fail_when: The present Data Catalog resource policy is public under Prowler's audited-account test.
aws.cb.glue.catalog_policy_not_public.not_applicable_when: GetResourcePolicy returned the explicit absent marker for the Data Catalog policy.

aws.cb.glue.connection_jdbc_enforce_ssl.description: For each glue connection, the evaluator flags FAIL when a JDBC connection's ConnectionProperties.JDBC_ENFORCE_SSL is not the string 'true'. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the glue connection.
aws.cb.glue.connection_jdbc_enforce_ssl.fail_when: A JDBC connection's ConnectionProperties.JDBC_ENFORCE_SSL is not the string 'true'.

aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_bookmarks_encry.description: For each glue dev endpoint, the evaluator flags FAIL when the dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its JobBookmarksEncryptionMode is DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue dev endpoint.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_bookmarks_encry.pass_when: Its resolved security configuration has JobBookmarksEncryptionMode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_bookmarks_encry.fail_when: The dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its JobBookmarksEncryptionMode is DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_cloudwatch_encr.description: For each glue dev endpoint, the evaluator flags FAIL when the dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its CloudWatchEncryptionMode is DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue dev endpoint.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_cloudwatch_encr.pass_when: Its resolved security configuration has CloudWatchEncryptionMode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_cloudwatch_encr.fail_when: The dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its CloudWatchEncryptionMode is DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_a.description: For each glue dev endpoint, the evaluator flags FAIL when any S3Encryption entry in the endpoint's attached configuration has S3EncryptionMode DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue dev endpoint.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_a.pass_when: Every present S3Encryption entry has a mode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_a.fail_when: Any S3Encryption entry in the endpoint's attached configuration has S3EncryptionMode DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_a.not_applicable_when: The resource has no resolvable Glue security configuration or its configuration has no S3Encryption entries.

aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_f.description: For each glue dev endpoint, the evaluator flags FAIL when the dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its first S3EncryptionMode is DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue dev endpoint.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_f.pass_when: The first S3Encryption entry of its attached configuration is enabled.
aws.cb.glue.dev_endpoint_s3_encryption_f.fail_when: The dev endpoint has no resolvable security configuration or its first S3EncryptionMode is DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.job_bookmarks_encryption.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when the job has no resolvable security configuration or its JobBookmarksEncryptionMode is DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue job.
aws.cb.glue.job_bookmarks_encryption.pass_when: Its resolved security configuration has JobBookmarksEncryptionMode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.job_bookmarks_encryption.fail_when: The job has no resolvable security configuration or its JobBookmarksEncryptionMode is DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.job_cloudwatch_encryption.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when the job has no resolvable security configuration or its CloudWatchEncryptionMode is DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue job.
aws.cb.glue.job_cloudwatch_encryption.pass_when: Its resolved security configuration has CloudWatchEncryptionMode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.job_cloudwatch_encryption.fail_when: The job has no resolvable security configuration or its CloudWatchEncryptionMode is DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.job_continuous_cloudwatch_lo.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when DefaultArgumentFlags['--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log'] is not the string 'true'. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the glue job is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.glue.job_continuous_cloudwatch_lo.pass_when: That allowlisted job argument is exactly 'true'.

aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_all_modes.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when any S3Encryption entry in the job's attached configuration has S3EncryptionMode DISABLED. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue job.
aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_all_modes.pass_when: Every present S3Encryption entry has a mode other than DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_all_modes.fail_when: Any S3Encryption entry in the job's attached configuration has S3EncryptionMode DISABLED.
aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_all_modes.not_applicable_when: The resource has no resolvable Glue security configuration or its configuration has no S3Encryption entries.

aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_first_mode.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when the first S3EncryptionMode is DISABLED, or an unconfigured job lacks the '--encryption-type' value sse-s3. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue job.
aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_first_mode.pass_when: Its attached configuration has an enabled first S3 mode or the unconfigured job uses sse-s3.
aws.cb.glue.job_s3_encryption_first_mode.fail_when: The first S3EncryptionMode is DISABLED, or an unconfigured job lacks the '--encryption-type' value sse-s3.

aws.cb.glue.ml_transform_encryption_conf.description: For each glue ml transform, the evaluator flags FAIL when TransformEncryption is absent on the ML transform. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue ml transform.
aws.cb.glue.ml_transform_encryption_conf.fail_when: TransformEncryption is absent on the ML transform.

aws.cb.glue.ml_transform_user_data_encry.description: For each glue ml transform, the evaluator flags FAIL when MlUserDataEncryptionMode is DISABLED or omitted. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the glue ml transform.
aws.cb.glue.ml_transform_user_data_encry.pass_when: MlUserDataEncryptionMode is present and not DISABLED.

aws.cb.glue.spark_job_version_3.description: For each glue job, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Spark-UI-enabled job has a numeric GlueVersion below 3.0. Known vulnerabilities can remain exploitable in the glue job while it runs an old release.
aws.cb.glue.spark_job_version_3.pass_when: A Spark-UI-enabled job has numeric GlueVersion at least 3.0.
aws.cb.glue.spark_job_version_3.fail_when: A Spark-UI-enabled job has a numeric GlueVersion below 3.0.
aws.cb.glue.spark_job_version_3.not_applicable_when: The job does not set --enable-spark-ui to the string true.

aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_recently_scan.description: For each inspector2 coverage, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ACTIVE covered resource has no lastScannedAt without a pending reason, or its last scan is more than three days before snapshot time. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the inspector2 coverage is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_recently_scan.pass_when: An ACTIVE resource has a lastScannedAt within three days of snapshot time.
aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_recently_scan.fail_when: An ACTIVE covered resource has no lastScannedAt without a pending reason, or its last scan is more than three days before snapshot time.
aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_recently_scan.not_applicable_when: scanStatus.statusCode is not ACTIVE, or an ACTIVE resource has no lastScannedAt and a pending scanStatus.reason.

aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_scan_active.description: For each inspector2 coverage, the evaluator flags FAIL when scanStatus.statusCode is not ACTIVE and scanStatus.reason is not one of the explicit skip reasons. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the inspector2 coverage is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_scan_active.fail_when: ScanStatus.statusCode is not ACTIVE and scanStatus.reason is not one of the explicit skip reasons.
aws.cb.inspector2.coverage_scan_active.not_applicable_when: scanStatus.reason is in the evaluator’s explicit skip reason list.

aws.cb.inspector2.enabled_for_present_re.description: For each inspector2 account status, the evaluator flags FAIL when Inspector2 account status or a scan type is not ENABLED for a resource type actually present in the region. An unscanned or overdue finding can leave an exploitable workload flaw undetected.
aws.cb.inspector2.enabled_for_present_re.pass_when: The account and every present EC2, ECR, Lambda, or Lambda Code scan type are ENABLED.
aws.cb.inspector2.enabled_for_present_re.fail_when: Inspector2 account status or a scan type is not ENABLED for a resource type actually present in the region.
aws.cb.inspector2.enabled_for_present_re.not_applicable_when: The region has no EC2 instances, ECR repositories, or Lambda functions.

aws.cb.inspector2.findings_within_max_ag.description: Compares each active Inspector2 finding’s firstObservedAt with the snapshot clock. A finding older than 192 days makes the enabled region FAIL.
aws.cb.inspector2.findings_within_max_ag.pass_when: No active finding exceeds 192 days of age.
aws.cb.inspector2.findings_within_max_ag.fail_when: An active Inspector2 finding's firstObservedAt is more than 192 days before snapshot time.
aws.cb.inspector2.findings_within_max_ag.not_applicable_when: Inspector2 account status is not ENABLED in the region.

aws.cb.inspector2.kev_findings_within_du.description: Checks the CISA due date on each active Inspector2 finding with KEV data. A due date before the snapshot clock makes the enabled region FAIL.
aws.cb.inspector2.kev_findings_within_du.pass_when: No active CISA KEV finding is past its due date.
aws.cb.inspector2.kev_findings_within_du.fail_when: An active finding has CISA cisaData.dateDue before snapshot time.
aws.cb.inspector2.kev_findings_within_du.not_applicable_when: Inspector2 account status is not ENABLED in the region.

aws.cb.inspector2.no_active_findings.description: Checks the complete regional inventory of active Inspector2 findings when Inspector2 is enabled. Any finding makes the regional result FAIL until it is remediated or suppressed.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_active_findings.pass_when: The enabled region has no active Inspector2 findings.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_active_findings.fail_when: The enabled regional Inspector2 inventory contains any active finding.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_active_findings.not_applicable_when: Inspector2 account status is not ENABLED in the region.

aws.cb.inspector2.no_known_exploited_fin.description: Checks active Inspector2 findings for CISA known exploited vulnerability data. Any matching finding makes the enabled region FAIL.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_known_exploited_fin.pass_when: None of the active findings have CISA KEV data.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_known_exploited_fin.fail_when: An active finding's details include CISA cisaData for a vulnerability ID.
aws.cb.inspector2.no_known_exploited_fin.not_applicable_when: Inspector2 account status is not ENABLED in the region.

aws.cb.kafka.cmk_encryption_at_rest.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when an MSK provisioned cluster does not declare a customer-managed KMS key for broker storage. An AWS-managed default key gives the account less control over key policy and disable or rotation decisions for this data.
aws.cb.kafka.cmk_encryption_at_rest.pass_when: Broker storage names a customer-managed KMS key, or the cluster is Serverless and AWS manages this setting.
aws.cb.kafka.cmk_encryption_at_rest.fail_when: An MSK provisioned cluster does not declare a customer-managed KMS key for broker storage.

aws.cb.kafka.enhanced_monitoring.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when EnhancedMonitoring is DEFAULT rather than a broker-level enhanced mode. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the msk cluster is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.kafka.enhanced_monitoring.pass_when: EnhancedMonitoring is not DEFAULT, or the cluster is Serverless and AWS manages this setting.
aws.cb.kafka.enhanced_monitoring.fail_when: EnhancedMonitoring is DEFAULT rather than a broker-level enhanced mode.

aws.cb.kafka.latest_version.description: Checks a provisioned MSK cluster against its broker-type-compatible Kafka update targets returned by GetCompatibleKafkaVersions and listed ACTIVE/DEPRECATED version statuses. It does not trust ListKafkaVersions order or demand a globally newest version. Remediation: Review cluster-compatible ACTIVE target versions and plan a supported upgrade with the workload owner; do not assume the API list is ordered.
aws.cb.kafka.latest_version.pass_when: The current version is ACTIVE and no newer ACTIVE compatible target is reported for this cluster.
aws.cb.kafka.latest_version.fail_when: The current version is DEPRECATED, or a newer ACTIVE compatible target exists; missing, ambiguous or malformed facts are UNKNOWN.
aws.cb.kafka.latest_version.not_applicable_when: Serverless clusters, whose Kafka version is managed by AWS.

aws.cb.kafka.mutual_tls_authentication.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when Provisioned.ClientAuthentication.Tls.Enabled is false. Without client certificates, a broker may accept clients that cannot prove an approved identity.
aws.cb.kafka.mutual_tls_authentication.pass_when: The provisioned cluster has mutual TLS client authentication enabled, or the cluster is Serverless and AWS manages this setting.

aws.cb.kafka.public_access_disabled.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when Provisioned.BrokerNodeGroupInfo.ConnectivityInfo.PublicAccess.Type is not DISABLED. This can give unintended external principals a route to the msk cluster or its data.
aws.cb.kafka.public_access_disabled.pass_when: Public broker access Type is DISABLED, or the cluster is Serverless and private with IAM authentication.

aws.cb.kafka.tls_client_and_in_cluster.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when client-broker encryption is not TLS or in-cluster encryption is not enabled. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the msk cluster.
aws.cb.kafka.tls_client_and_in_cluster.pass_when: TLS client-broker and in-cluster encryption are both enabled, or the cluster is Serverless and AWS manages this setting.
aws.cb.kafka.tls_client_and_in_cluster.fail_when: Client-broker encryption is not TLS or in-cluster encryption is not enabled.

aws.cb.kafka.unauthenticated_access_disa.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when Provisioned.ClientAuthentication.Unauthenticated.Enabled is true. Weak identity controls can let an unintended principal act on the msk cluster or its data.
aws.cb.kafka.unauthenticated_access_disa.pass_when: Unauthenticated client access is false, or the cluster is Serverless and private with IAM authentication.

aws.cb.kinesis.customer_kms_key.description: For each kinesis stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when EncryptionType is not KMS or KeyId is exactly alias/aws/kinesis. An AWS-managed default key gives the account less control over key policy and disable or rotation decisions for this data.
aws.cb.kinesis.customer_kms_key.pass_when: EncryptionType is KMS and KeyId differs from alias/aws/kinesis.
aws.cb.kinesis.customer_kms_key.fail_when: EncryptionType is not KMS or KeyId is exactly alias/aws/kinesis.

aws.cb.kinesis.kms_encryption.description: For each kinesis stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when EncryptionType is not KMS, including when omitted. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the kinesis stream.
aws.cb.kinesis.kms_encryption.fail_when: EncryptionType is not KMS, including when omitted.

aws.cb.kinesis.retention_at_least_168h.description: For each kinesis stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when RetentionPeriodHours is below 168. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the kinesis stream.

aws.cb.kinesis.retention_exactly_168h.description: For each kinesis stream, the evaluator flags FAIL when RetentionPeriodHours differs from exactly 168, including longer retention. Retention below a week removes older events needed for replay or investigation; longer retention also fails this exact-equality policy.
aws.cb.kinesis.retention_exactly_168h.fail_when: RetentionPeriodHours differs from exactly 168, including longer retention.

aws.cb.lambda.cloudtrail_data_events.description: Checks for an actively logging, region-covering CloudTrail with a Lambda data event selector that admits Invoke for this function ARN. Basic and advanced selectors, including all restricting fields, are evaluated. Remediation: Configure an actively logging, region-covering trail with a Lambda data event selector proven to admit Invoke for the function ARN.
aws.cb.lambda.cloudtrail_data_events.pass_when: At least one active covering trail has a selector proven to admit Lambda Invoke for the function.
aws.cb.lambda.cloudtrail_data_events.fail_when: Complete evidence proves no active covering selector admits the event; unread, malformed or unresolved restrictive fields are UNKNOWN.

aws.cb.lambda.kms_key_configured.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when KMSKeyArn is absent or empty. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the lambda function.

aws.cb.lambda.logging_config_present.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when LoggingConfig is explicitly null. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the lambda function is absent or delayed.

aws.cb.lambda.policy_no_wildcard_allow.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when an Allow statement has wildcard Principal even if it also has restrictive conditions. A broad resource policy can grant operations to principals beyond the intended trust boundary.
aws.cb.lambda.policy_no_wildcard_allow.pass_when: The policy is absent or no Allow statement has wildcard Principal.
aws.cb.lambda.policy_no_wildcard_allow.fail_when: An Allow statement has wildcard Principal even if it also has restrictive conditions.

aws.cb.lambda.policy_prohibit_public_acc.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when the present function policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement. This can give unintended external principals a route to the lambda function or its data.
aws.cb.lambda.policy_prohibit_public_acc.pass_when: The present policy has no unrestricted public Allow statement.
aws.cb.lambda.policy_prohibit_public_acc.fail_when: The present function policy has an unrestricted public Allow statement.
aws.cb.lambda.policy_prohibit_public_acc.not_applicable_when: The function has no resource policy.

aws.cb.lambda.runtime_not_deprecated_lis.description: Compares a Zip Lambda managed runtime to AWS deprecation dates reviewed 2026-10-12 using the captured scan clock and 180-day review window. It tests support status, not the latest available runtime. Remediation: Upgrade to a currently supported managed runtime and recheck AWS lifecycle dates after the reviewed notice window.
aws.cb.lambda.runtime_not_deprecated_lis.pass_when: The known managed runtime is not deprecated at the captured scan date within the review window.
aws.cb.lambda.runtime_not_deprecated_lis.fail_when: The known managed runtime is deprecated at the captured scan date; unlisted runtimes or observations beyond the review window are UNKNOWN.
aws.cb.lambda.runtime_not_deprecated_lis.not_applicable_when: Image packages and Zip functions with custom OS-only provided runtimes.

aws.cb.lambda.vpc_multiple_az.description: For each lambda function, the evaluator flags FAIL when a VPC-attached function's listed subnets resolve to fewer than two distinct AvailabilityZoneId values. A zonal failure can interrupt the lambda function when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.lambda.vpc_multiple_az.pass_when: Its subnets span at least two distinct AvailabilityZoneId values.
aws.cb.lambda.vpc_multiple_az.fail_when: A VPC-attached function's listed subnets resolve to fewer than two distinct AvailabilityZoneId values.

aws.cb.lightsail.database_not_public.description: For each lightsail database, the evaluator flags FAIL when publiclyAccessible is true on a Lightsail relational database. This can give unintended external principals a route to the lightsail database or its data.
aws.cb.lightsail.database_not_public.fail_when: PubliclyAccessible is true on a Lightsail relational database.

aws.cb.lightsail.instance_auto_snapshot.description: For each lightsail instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when no addOns entry has name AutoSnapshot and status Enabled. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the lightsail instance.
aws.cb.lightsail.instance_auto_snapshot.fail_when: No addOns entry has name AutoSnapshot and status Enabled.

aws.cb.lightsail.instance_ipv6_disabled.description: For each lightsail instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when ipv6Addresses contains at least one address. An IPv6 address can expose a second network path that IPv4-only access rules and monitoring do not cover.
aws.cb.lightsail.instance_ipv6_disabled.fail_when: Ipv6Addresses contains at least one address.

aws.cb.lightsail.instance_not_public.description: For each lightsail instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when the instance has a publicIpAddress and at least one networking.ports entry with accessType public. This can give unintended external principals a route to the lightsail instance or its data.
aws.cb.lightsail.instance_not_public.pass_when: There is no public IP or no public port entry.
aws.cb.lightsail.instance_not_public.fail_when: The instance has a publicIpAddress and at least one networking.ports entry with accessType public.

aws.cb.lightsail.rdp_restricted.description: For each lightsail instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when a TCP networking port from 3389 to 3389 includes 0.0.0.0/0 in cidrs. World-reachable remote administration invites password guessing and direct compromise of the instance.
aws.cb.lightsail.rdp_restricted.fail_when: A TCP networking port from 3389 to 3389 includes 0.0.0.0/0 in cidrs.

aws.cb.lightsail.ssh_rdp_http_world_clos.description: Checks Lightsail TCP firewall rules for exact SSH 22, RDP 3389 and HTTP 80 ranges open to IPv4 or IPv6 world CIDRs. Remediation: Restrict world access to TCP 22, 3389 and 80 to approved source addresses or close the ports.
aws.cb.lightsail.ssh_rdp_http_world_clos.pass_when: No matching TCP 22, 3389 or 80 rule permits 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.
aws.cb.lightsail.ssh_rdp_http_world_clos.fail_when: A matching TCP 22, 3389 or 80 rule permits 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0.

aws.cb.lightsail.ssh_restricted.description: For each lightsail instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when a TCP networking port from 22 to 22 includes 0.0.0.0/0 in cidrs. World-reachable remote administration invites password guessing and direct compromise of the instance.
aws.cb.lightsail.ssh_restricted.fail_when: A TCP networking port from 22 to 22 includes 0.0.0.0/0 in cidrs.

aws.cb.lightsail.static_ip_attached.description: For each lightsail static ip, the evaluator flags FAIL when isAttached is false on a static IP. An unattached static IP can be reassigned or forgotten while DNS still directs clients to it.
aws.cb.lightsail.static_ip_attached.fail_when: IsAttached is false on a static IP.

aws.cb.macie.automated_discovery.description: For each macie session, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ENABLED Macie session has AutomatedDiscovery.status other than ENABLED. Sensitive S3 objects may go undiscovered after data is added or a bucket changes.
aws.cb.macie.automated_discovery.pass_when: Automated sensitive data discovery is ENABLED for the active session.
aws.cb.macie.automated_discovery.fail_when: An ENABLED Macie session has AutomatedDiscovery.status other than ENABLED.
aws.cb.macie.automated_discovery.not_applicable_when: The regional Macie session is absent or its status is not ENABLED.

aws.cb.macie.enabled_where_buckets.description: For each macie session, the evaluator flags FAIL when Macie session status is not ENABLED in a region containing at least one S3 bucket. Sensitive S3 objects may go undiscovered after data is added or a bucket changes.
aws.cb.macie.enabled_where_buckets.pass_when: Macie status is ENABLED in the bucket's region.
aws.cb.macie.enabled_where_buckets.fail_when: Macie session status is not ENABLED in a region containing at least one S3 bucket.
aws.cb.macie.enabled_where_buckets.not_applicable_when: Macie is not enabled and no S3 bucket resolves to the audited region.

aws.cb.mediastore.container_policy_not_p.description: Historical-only evaluation of a MediaStore container policy observed before the service shutdown; checks definite unrestricted public Allow statements. MediaStore is retired for current observations. Remediation: For historical observations only, remove unrestricted public Allows from the recorded policy; current MediaStore service shutdown makes this control not applicable.
aws.cb.mediastore.container_policy_not_p.pass_when: A pre-shutdown observed policy has no unrestricted public Allow.
aws.cb.mediastore.container_policy_not_p.fail_when: A pre-shutdown observed policy has an unrestricted public Allow; uncertain lifecycle timing is UNKNOWN.
aws.cb.mediastore.container_policy_not_p.not_applicable_when: Current retired-service observations, or a historical container with no policy.

aws.cb.memorydb.auto_minor_version_upgra.description: For each memorydb cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false on a MemoryDB cluster. Known vulnerabilities can remain exploitable in the memorydb cluster while it runs an old release.
aws.cb.memorydb.auto_minor_version_upgra.fail_when: AutoMinorVersionUpgrade is false on a MemoryDB cluster.

aws.cb.memorydb.tls_enabled.description: For each memorydb cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when TLSEnabled is false on a MemoryDB cluster. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the memorydb cluster.
aws.cb.memorydb.tls_enabled.fail_when: TLSEnabled is false on a MemoryDB cluster.

aws.cb.mq.activemq_active_standby.description: For each mq broker, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ActiveMQ broker's DeploymentMode is not ACTIVE_STANDBY_MULTI_AZ. A zonal failure can interrupt the mq broker when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.mq.activemq_active_standby.fail_when: An ActiveMQ broker's DeploymentMode is not ACTIVE_STANDBY_MULTI_AZ.

aws.cb.mq.activemq_audit_logs.description: For each mq broker, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ActiveMQ broker's Logs.Audit is not true. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the mq broker is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.mq.activemq_audit_logs.fail_when: An ActiveMQ broker's Logs.Audit is not true.

aws.cb.mq.engine_logging.description: For each mq broker, the evaluator flags FAIL when an ActiveMQ broker lacks either Logs.General or Logs.Audit, or another broker lacks Logs.General. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the mq broker is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.mq.engine_logging.pass_when: Required general and, for ActiveMQ, audit logs are enabled.
aws.cb.mq.engine_logging.fail_when: An ActiveMQ broker lacks General or Audit logging, a RabbitMQ broker lacks General logging, or the engine is neither ActiveMQ nor RabbitMQ.

aws.cb.mq.not_publicly_accessible.description: For each mq broker, the evaluator flags FAIL when PubliclyAccessible is true on an MQ broker. This can give unintended external principals a route to the mq broker or its data.
aws.cb.mq.not_publicly_accessible.fail_when: PubliclyAccessible is true on an MQ broker.

aws.cb.mq.rabbitmq_cluster_deployment.description: For each mq broker, the evaluator flags FAIL when a RabbitMQ broker's DeploymentMode is not CLUSTER_MULTI_AZ. A single-instance RabbitMQ broker can stop message delivery when its host or Availability Zone fails.
aws.cb.mq.rabbitmq_cluster_deployment.fail_when: A RabbitMQ broker's DeploymentMode is not CLUSTER_MULTI_AZ.

aws.cb.msk.client_broker_tls.description: For each msk cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when the MSK cluster's client-broker encryption is not TLS only. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the msk cluster.
aws.cb.msk.client_broker_tls.fail_when: The MSK cluster's client-broker encryption is not TLS only.

aws.cb.mskconnect.log_delivery.description: For each mskconnect connector, the evaluator flags FAIL when logDelivery is absent from the connector summary. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the mskconnect connector is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.mskconnect.log_delivery.pass_when: LogDelivery is present, regardless of its worker destinations.
aws.cb.mskconnect.log_delivery.fail_when: LogDelivery is absent from the connector summary.

aws.cb.mskconnect.tls_to_cluster.description: For each mskconnect connector, the evaluator flags FAIL when kafkaClusterEncryptionInTransit.encryptionType is not TLS. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the mskconnect connector.
aws.cb.mskconnect.tls_to_cluster.pass_when: The connector's cluster encryption type is TLS.

aws.cb.neptune.audit_log_export.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Neptune cluster's EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports omits audit. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the neptune cluster is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.neptune.audit_log_export.fail_when: A Neptune cluster's EnabledCloudwatchLogsExports omits audit.
aws.cb.neptune.audit_log_export.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.backup_retention_7_days.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when BackupRetentionPeriod is below seven days. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the neptune cluster.
aws.cb.neptune.backup_retention_7_days.pass_when: BackupRetentionPeriod is at least seven days.
aws.cb.neptune.backup_retention_7_days.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.copy_tags_to_snapshot.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when CopyTagsToSnapshot is false. Deletion or corruption may leave too little recoverable history to restore the neptune cluster.
aws.cb.neptune.copy_tags_to_snapshot.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.deletion_protection.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when DeletionProtection is false. An accidental or malicious delete can remove the neptune cluster before recovery is arranged.
aws.cb.neptune.deletion_protection.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.iam_authentication.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when IAMDatabaseAuthenticationEnabled is false or omitted. Weak identity controls can let an unintended principal act on the neptune cluster or its data.
aws.cb.neptune.iam_authentication.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.multi_az.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when MultiAZ is false. A zonal failure can interrupt the neptune cluster when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.neptune.multi_az.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_prowler.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when a DB subnet group member has a default IPv4 route through an internet gateway. This can give unintended external principals a route to the neptune cluster or its data.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_prowler.pass_when: No group subnet has an internet-gateway default route.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_prowler.fail_when: A DB subnet group member has a default IPv4 route through an internet gateway.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_prowler.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_steampip.description: Checks whether a Neptune DB subnet group includes a subnet with an effective 0.0.0.0/0 route to an internet gateway. NAT-only routes are outbound and do not make a subnet public for this test. Remediation: Use DB subnets without an internet-gateway default route; inspect security groups and effective ingress separately.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_steampip.pass_when: No joined subnet has an effective internet-gateway default route.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_steampip.fail_when: A joined subnet has an effective internet-gateway default route; unresolved joins are UNKNOWN.
aws.cb.neptune.no_public_subnet_steampip.not_applicable_when: The resource engine is not Neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_encrypted.description: For each rds cluster snapshot, the evaluator flags FAIL when a Neptune cluster snapshot has StorageEncrypted false. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the rds cluster snapshot.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_encrypted.fail_when: A Neptune cluster snapshot has StorageEncrypted false.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_encrypted.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_not_public_prowl.description: For each rds cluster snapshot, the evaluator flags FAIL when any snapshot restore attribute includes 'all' among its AttributeValues. This can give unintended external principals a route to the rds cluster snapshot or its data.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_not_public_prowl.fail_when: Any snapshot restore attribute includes 'all' among its AttributeValues.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_not_public_prowl.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_restore_not_all_.description: For Neptune cluster snapshots, checks the restore attribute for membership of all, including a list mixed with account IDs. Missing, malformed or denied restore attributes remain UNKNOWN.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_restore_not_all_.pass_when: The restore attribute does not include all.
aws.cb.neptune.snapshot_restore_not_all_.not_applicable_when: The snapshot Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.neptune.storage_encrypted.description: For each neptune cluster, the evaluator flags FAIL when StorageEncrypted is false on a Neptune cluster. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the neptune cluster.
aws.cb.neptune.storage_encrypted.fail_when: StorageEncrypted is false on a Neptune cluster.
aws.cb.neptune.storage_encrypted.not_applicable_when: The resource Engine is not neptune.

aws.cb.opensearch.access_policy_not_publ.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when a domain outside a VPC has a public access-policy Allow statement. This can give unintended external principals a route to the opensearch domain or its data.
aws.cb.opensearch.access_policy_not_publ.pass_when: A non-VPC domain's access policy is not public.
aws.cb.opensearch.access_policy_not_publ.fail_when: A domain outside a VPC has a public access-policy Allow statement.

aws.cb.opensearch.audit_logs_enabled.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when LogPublishingOptions.AUDIT_LOGS.Enabled is not true. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the opensearch domain is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.opensearch.audit_logs_enabled.pass_when: AUDIT_LOGS.Enabled is true, regardless of destination ARN.

aws.cb.opensearch.cognito_dashboards_aut.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when CognitoOptions.Enabled is not true. Weak identity controls can let an unintended principal act on the opensearch domain or its data.

aws.cb.opensearch.cognito_or_saml_dashbo.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when neither CognitoOptions.Enabled nor AdvancedSecurityOptions.SAMLOptions.Enabled is true. Weak identity controls can let an unintended principal act on the opensearch domain or its data.
aws.cb.opensearch.cognito_or_saml_dashbo.pass_when: Either Cognito or SAML Dashboards authentication is enabled.

aws.cb.opensearch.data_node_fault_tolera.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when ClusterConfig.InstanceCount is below three or ZoneAwarenessEnabled is false. A zonal failure can interrupt the opensearch domain when the surviving zone lacks a usable replica.
aws.cb.opensearch.data_node_fault_tolera.pass_when: At least three data nodes and zone awareness are configured.
aws.cb.opensearch.data_node_fault_tolera.fail_when: ClusterConfig.InstanceCount is below three or ZoneAwarenessEnabled is false.

aws.cb.opensearch.dedicated_master_nodes.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when dedicated master nodes are disabled or DedicatedMasterCount is below three. Too few dedicated masters can prevent cluster elections and interrupt indexing or search during a node failure.
aws.cb.opensearch.dedicated_master_nodes.pass_when: Dedicated masters are enabled with count at least three.
aws.cb.opensearch.dedicated_master_nodes.fail_when: Dedicated master nodes are disabled or DedicatedMasterCount is below three.

aws.cb.opensearch.enabled_logs_have_log_.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when LogPublishingOptions is absent or an enabled audit, error, search-slow, or index-slow log type lacks CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn. Operators can miss failures or malicious activity because the evidence from the opensearch domain is absent or delayed.
aws.cb.opensearch.enabled_logs_have_log_.pass_when: Publishing options exist and every enabled log type has a log group ARN.
aws.cb.opensearch.enabled_logs_have_log_.fail_when: LogPublishingOptions is absent or an enabled audit, error, search-slow, or index-slow log type lacks CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn.

aws.cb.opensearch.encryption_at_rest.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when EncryptionAtRestOptions.Enabled is false. A stolen storage copy or overbroad key access can disclose data held by the opensearch domain.

aws.cb.opensearch.enforce_https.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when DomainEndpointOptions.EnforceHTTPS is false. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the opensearch domain.

aws.cb.opensearch.fine_grained_access_co.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when AdvancedSecurityOptions.Enabled is false or omitted. Without fine-grained roles, a domain-level caller can reach indices and operations beyond its intended permissions.

aws.cb.opensearch.in_vpc_private_subnets.description: For each opensearch domain, the evaluator flags FAIL when the domain lacks VPCOptions.VPCId or any listed VPC subnet is explicitly public under the route-table test. The network path can expose the opensearch domain to traffic from outside its intended boundary.
aws.cb.opensearch.in_vpc_private_subnets.pass_when: VPCId exists and none of its listed subnets is public.
aws.cb.opensearch.in_vpc_private_subnets.fail_when: The domain lacks VPCOptions.VPCId or any listed VPC subnet is explicitly public under the route-table test.

aws.cb.opensearch.internal_user_database.description: Tests the source-specific OpenSearch internal user database disabled profile, suitable only where another owner authentication model is intended. It conflicts with the enabled profile on the same domain. Remediation: Use IAM or SAML instead of the internal user database only when that authentication profile is intended; verify the replacement identity controls.

aws.cb.rds.parameter_group_critical_even.pass_when: At least one enabled parameter-group subscription covers configuration change or all categories.
aws.cb.rds.parameter_group_critical_even.fail_when: A region with RDS instances has no enabled db-parameter-group subscription covering configuration change.
aws.cb.rds.parameter_group_critical_even.not_applicable_when: The region has no RDS instances.

aws.cb.rds.postgres_force_ssl_parameter.description: For each rds instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when a PostgreSQL instance parameter group's rds.force_ssl is not '1'. Client or service traffic may be intercepted or modified before it reaches the rds instance.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_force_ssl_parameter.fail_when: A PostgreSQL instance parameter group's rds.force_ssl is not '1'.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_force_ssl_parameter.not_applicable_when: The instance Engine is neither postgres nor sqlserver under this exact source predicate.

aws.cb.rds.postgres_local_file_read_vers.description: For each rds instance, the evaluator flags FAIL when a PostgreSQL instance EngineVersion equals 10.11, 10.12, 10.13, 11.6, 11.7, or 11.8. Known vulnerabilities can remain exploitable in the rds instance while it runs an old release.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_local_file_read_vers.pass_when: EngineVersion is outside that exact vulnerable-version list.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_local_file_read_vers.fail_when: A PostgreSQL instance EngineVersion equals 10.11, 10.12, 10.13, 11.6, 11.7, or 11.8.
aws.cb.rds.postgres_local_file_read_vers.not_applicable_when: The instance Engine is not exactly postgres.
